not_found.note: released: dein-dlrp June quoted line 'Anna & Elsa Party Fieber Outfit Pin (unlimitiert) 7,99' - one joint pin, separate from the two solo lines
released: quoted June line is a single 'Pin' naming both Anna and Elsa at one price; one pin with two characters
released: dein-dlrp June quoted line 'Anna Party Fieber Outfit Pin (unlimitiert): 7,99' - own item
released: dein-dlrp June quoted line 'Elsa Party Fieber Outfit Pin (unlimitiert): 7,99' - own item, described in page text
variant: same pin as dlp/2015/september-2015-le/dopey (Sept page quote: Seppl/Dopey stage pin, LE 700; no Jiminy in that article)
hold kept: Oct page again shows only two 2016 singles (medal 6.99, sorcerer Mickey with pink Minnie 8.99); still a merge candidate with mickey-sorcerer-2016
hold kept: no source compares CM Mickey Vampire (3015, 22 Sep) with OE park Mickey vampire; do not merge
hold kept: passiondlp Q3 has a Dreams gaway category but snippet names no design; Shadow giveaway still rests on one forum recap
hold kept: April page calls it a new Remy attraction pin, but no source compares it with the Feb retro-series Ratatouille LE; do not merge yet
hold kept: no new source; Disney Pins Blog Oct 2015 page snippet does not list booster contents; Earfall Tower naming unresolved
hold kept: not re-searched; no per-design evidence for the 8 princess booster records
hold kept: Diskingdom and La Gazette de Mickey snippets do not describe the 1. Cinderella Ball design
hold kept: passiondlp Q4 says 'locket pins' showing before and after midnight; number of pins still not stated
Four PTD pins still unnamed. A March forum post lists 25 Apr princess OE and Ursula/Jessica LE releases and guesses a Peter Pan theme; speculation, not recorded
lead: April overview names an LE 700 14.99 pin 'Anniversaire 12 Avril 15'; supports 12 Apr, but summary lists it beside the '1992 D 2015' pin - same pin not confirmed
April page: blue border, red banner reading '1992 D 2015', LE 700, Pueblo only, EUR 14.99 (summary of page text)
Three LE 1000 pins still unnamed; Gazette thread repeats Sven LE 500 13.99, others LE 1000 14.99, 2 of each per buyer, Sven sold out fast
Conflict: passiondlp Q2 announced the PTD at Pueblo Trading Post; Gazette thread has collectors queuing at the Liberty Arcade exit (queue point, sale venue unclear)
Mini-jumbo and Refresh Lanyard pin still undescribed; passiondlp Q2 lists them with Flora, Cleo, Big Bad Wolf; edition sizes and prices not found
2015 Refresh Lanyard designs still unnamed; Chronique Disney (2018) says DLP Refresh pins carry a nametag shape, given at PTNs with a Trader cocktail purchase
Four gaways, mini-jumbo and event pins still unnamed. Central Plaza pre-event thread: smaller ballroom, about 300 places, LE 600 per organiser; castle jumbo only a guess
Round pins and jumbo still unnamed. Gazette de Mickey recap: Predalle signed pins, jumbo price criticised; forum puts jumbo at EUR 69. Salon Mickey: 350 places, EUR 45 with brunch
Event pins still not itemised. Gazette de Mickey recap: leftover pins at Pueblo until 3 Jan 2016, except gaways and mini-jumbo kept for a later event
Still only Vader and Yoda named (Dedicated to DLP); dein-dlrp line Booster SW Cutes, 4 pins, unlimited, 18.99; no other designs found
Other three Christmas Mickey designs still unnamed; Dedicated to DLP Sept post gives 26 Sep and a 9.99 lanyard only
Villains still not confirmed. Lead: two summaries of the Dec page say the Snow White witch (Evil Queen) wishes a happy new year with her apple; garbled with a Tink section, not recorded
lead: Dec page summaries mention a section 'Tinkerbell als Botin des Fruehjahrs' near an LE 700 Pueblo pin; may be the villain pin text. No Tink LE 700 pin recorded
lead: Gazette CM series page says the 2015 CM Exclusive (LE 3015) cost EUR 5, sold at internal shop Jessica on CM ID; not clear it covers all four 2015 CM pins
Designs of the 2015 CM pins (Panpan, Gusteau, Mickey Vampire, Pluto Noel) still not described; Gusteau marks the ride 1st anniversary (passiondlp Q3)
Characters on Coffee Date still not named; only line item in dein-dlrp Oct quick overview, no design text
Conflict: one Oct search summary calls the four retro pins a booster; quoted lines list each at 7.99 unlimited. Packet 388 format (sold singly) kept; confirm
Dedicated to DLP's 8th Frozen pin still unidentified; dein-dlrp June gives five 7.99 pins plus 6.99 Olaf Summer

discovery_notes: Follow-up 6 of B037 (DLP 2015). 30 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet, blocked domains passed. Reuses 330-388 keys; no 2016 packets duplicated. No new pins. Released: Party Fever trio (quoted June lines), Jiminy stage = Seppl/Dopey. Added: PTD Apr venue, PTN 87th/89th.
